title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Packages: Entry Thresholds, Card Plans and Portal Seats
content:
The Paystride Payroll Card Program is sold in six packages. Each package has an entry threshold of active cardholders, sets the card plan the employer's workers receive, includes a number of employer administrator seats on the employer portal, and carries Paystride's launch target.

| Package | Active cardholders needed to enter | Worker card plan | Employer portal seats included | Launch target (business days after signing) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 1 | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Essential | 2 | 10 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 25 | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Standard | 3 | 10 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 100 | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Select | 5 | 15 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 250 | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage | 10 | 20 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 1000 | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier | 25 | 30 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 5000 | Paystride Visa Payroll Card Elite | 50 | 45 |

### Features common to every package

| Feature | All six packages |
|---|---|
| Employer portal roles allowed to request load reversals, package changes and termination | program owner, payroll administrator |
| Workers paid on the card are offered fee-free early wage transfers to it when the employer also runs Earned Wage Access | yes |

### Points of reference

- The worker card plan follows the package: workers of an employer in the Premier package hold the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier plan.
- The launch target is the number of business days after signing within which Paystride commits to deliver launch kits and accept the first load file.
- The employer portal roles listed are the same in every package; the human resources and view-only finance roles of the portal are not among them.

Hypothetical illustration: an employer with 180 active cardholders meets the entry thresholds of the Essential, Standard and Select packages and not those of the Advantage, Premier or Elite packages.
